This article is a stub. Seagull Enterprises, renamed Seagull Inc. by 1977, was a California
company that was Omega's exclusive representative for swim timing in the United States and
Canada through the 1970s, selling the [OSM-4](../equipment/swimming/timers/osm-4.md) and
[OSM-5](../equipment/swimming/timers/osm-5.md) systems.

By late 1979 Omega was selling through its own American office, later the address of
[Sportyme](sportyme.md); see the [vendors](index.md) register for the companies this wiki
covers.
